title: Milestone dependency slate and readiness tracker
content:
Purpose:
This is a working slate for Q4 roadmap milestones that maps each milestone to critical dependencies, launch readiness gates, and the headline KPIs we will use to decide go/no-go. Designed for product-ops + PM + eng leads to run a weekly triage. Not a final launch doc — think of this as the canonical dependency-first tracker that feeds the formal launch playbook.

How to use:
- Update the status column weekly before the triage call.
- Flag any "Blocker" entries in Slack #launch-ops with the tag and owner.
- If a milestone hits "amber" or "red" two weeks out, schedule an ad-hoc readiness review.

Milestones (summary table - textified):
1) Hosted API: streaming stability (MILESTONE-ID: HOST-STREAM-3)
   - Target launch window: 2025-11-18 to 2025-11-25
   - Lead: Arjun Patel
   - Core KPI: 99th pct latency for streaming < 350ms (prod simulated traffic), token success rate > 99.5%
   - Dependencies: runtime kernel patch (ENG-RUN-589), metrics export schema change (OBS-202), integration test harness for partial shard failover (SRE-445)
   - Current status: amber
   - Readiness gate checklist (short):
       * Kernel patch merged to staging (owner: Connor Mills) — due 2025-10-30 — status: done
       * E2E streaming harness run (owner: Arjun) — due 2025-11-05 — status: in_progress
       * Load test with 95th/99th error injection (owner: SRE) — due 2025-11-07 — status: blocked (test infra quota)
   - Blockers: test infra quota (owner: Priya Nair) — mitigation: request burst quota or run staged smaller shards

2) Dedicated: burst autoscale policy (MILESTONE-ID: DED-BURST-1)
   - Target: 2025-12-02
   - Lead: Layla Gomez
   - Core KPI: Mean scale-up time < 45s for +25% sustained load; no more than 1% dropped connections during scale
   - Dependencies: autoscaler controller flags, billing commit for burst capacity, canary infra for scale exercises
   - Status: green
   - Readiness tasks: canary exercise scheduled 2025-11-18 (owner: Layla), billing commit signed (owner: Finance — Alice R.) — done

3) Private: VPC private-control-plane GA (MILESTONE-ID: PRIV-CP-GA)
   - Target: 2025-12-16
   - Lead: Priya Nair
   - Core KPI: Customer onboarding time <= 3 days (post-gated checklist), KMS integration worked in 3/3 test orgs
   - Dependencies: hardened audit logging (SEC-301), KMS integration docs, on-prem packaging test
   - Status: amber
   - Readiness checklist: security review complete, packaging scripts tested, install runbook validated

Dependency matrix (prioritized):
- Kernel patch (ENG-RUN-589): impacts HOST-STREAM-3, PRIV-CP-GA — critical path for streaming latency; contingency: fallback to previous kernel with feature toggle
- Metrics schema change (OBS-202): impacts monitoring for HOST-STREAM-3; non-blocking if temporary shim added but affects KPI validity
- Billing contract for burst (FIN-122): impacts DED-BURST-1; must be signed 3 weeks before GA to enable committed capacity purchase

KPI tracker (weekly snapshot, sample rows):
- Row format: [milestone, KPI, baseline, target, current, delta, measurement-owner, last-check]
- Example: [HOST-STREAM-3, 99th-latency(ms), 420, 350, 372, -18, Arjun Patel, 2025-10-28]
- Example: [DED-BURST-1, scale-up-time(s), 58, 45, 42, +16, Layla Gomez, 2025-10-27]

Risk register (condensed):
- Risk: shared test infra saturation — Likelihood: high; Impact: high; Mitigation: schedule dedicated time windows, request quota bump, or synthetic lightweight tests that validate the gating behavior. Owner: Priya Nair.
- Risk: KPI drift due to metrics-schema migration — Likelihood: medium; Impact: medium; Mitigation: dual-writing (old + new) for 1 week, tagging telemetry. Owner: Connor Mills.
- Risk: late legal/compliance signoff for private deployment — Likelihood: low; Impact: high; Mitigation: early engagement with SEC and separate approval fast-path. Owner: Maya Chen.

Launch readiness gates (go/no-go template):
- Technical: core infra tickets closed or have documented fallbacks; production smoke tests passing; error budget check (SRE) within SLO.
- Product: acceptance tests for top-5 customer flows passing; docs and SDKs published; quickstart template validated.
- Business: pricing & billing finalized for feature, sales enablement package ready, legal/compliance OK.
- Ops: runbook published, on-call rota assigned, incident playbooks updated.
- If any of the 5 categories has a "red" flag within 72 hours of target GA, the milestone must move to a deferred window unless an executive exception is approved.

Weekly triage agenda (30min):
- 0-5m: quick status roll (green/amber/red) per milestone
- 5-18m: deep-dive on amber/red items (owner speaks to mitigation plan + ETA)
- 18-25m: cross-milestone dependency conflicts (scheduling, infra quota, staffing)
- 25-30m: decisions / actions / owners recap

Post-launch measurement hooks (first 14 days):
- Daily KPI snapshot at 9am PST for top-level KPIs (latency, error-rate, token-success). Owner: Observability (Connor)
- Rollout phasing: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 48h observation windows between increases; automatic rollback triggers on sustained KPI degradation
- Customer feedback: dedicated survey + NPS pulse at 7 and 30 days (owner: CS - Elena Ruiz)

Open questions (for PMs):
- Do we need an explicit regression guardrail for embeddings that share the same model-serving path? (action: product to decide by 2025-11-03)
- Are we comfortable with dual-write telemetry for metrics migration from day 1? (action: observations team)

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally compact — the full launch runbook will be generated from the final set of rows that are green three days prior to GA.
- Replace the short KPI snapshots with links to the weekly metric dashboards once finalized (linked_artifacts above will be updated).
- If you are owner of a blocker, add a 1-line mitigation update in the doc before the weekly sync.

Revision history (brief):
- 2025-09-18: initial draft (Maya)
- 2025-10-02: added Dedicated autoscale rows + KPIs (Layla)
- 2025-10-28: updated HOST-STREAM-3 latency baselines after perf run (Arjun)
- 2025-11-02: recorded infra quota blocker and mitigation (Priya)

Quick action list (next 7 days):
- Priya: escalate infra quota request to cloud provider — due 2025-10-30
- Connor: enable dual-write metric shim for streaming metrics — due 2025-10-31
- Arjun: complete E2E streaming harness and post results — due 2025-11-05
- Layla: run Dedicated canary scale exercise and publish notes — due 2025-11-18

-- end of slate --
